item.title: SPEAR: An Engineering Case Study of Multi-Agent Coordination for Smart Contract Auditing
item.description:
Summary

  • Proposes SPEAR, a multi-agent coordination framework specifically for smart contract auditing.
  • Uses specialized agents (planning, execution/task allocation, and repair) to handle auditing workflow, negotiation/auction coordination, and automated recovery from brittle artifacts.
  • Evaluates multi-agent vs centralized/pipeline alternatives under controlled failure scenarios, measuring coordination, recovery behavior, and resource use.

Paper Type

  • Research

Additional Information

  • Authors: ['Indraveni Chebolu', 'Arnab Mallick', 'Harmesh Rana']
  • Tags: ['Smart contract security', 'Automated auditing', 'Multi-agent systems', 'Vulnerability detection']
